notes.title: ButtonBros VS Mode Updates are now available.
notes.content:
After experiencing all kinds of thrilling adventure experiences in the hands of players, the buttons finally gathered together, and in many players'reports, we found that the players were eager for a platform to play with their partners, so we made a big collection, let the buttons all move up! 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/63cba35d3d7cad120cca1900a6aa51795fb325ca.png

What's new? 

New Game Mode!

 In the VS Mode, we have set up two modes of victory for everyone to choose. 
 The first is the occupancy point mode, in which you need to stand at the luminous spot continuously and steadily to get the score. The longer the occupancy time, the higher the score! 
 The second is the survival mode, in which everyone has a fixed number of lives, you need to protect yourself and defeat each other! 
 Up to four partners can play at the same time. 
 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/a17f02329cf16d6bcff6eaa27c2cb5303b9b322b.gifhttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/5635901d800b3ef64442ebb5d57c78965334aa03.gif
New maps. 

 You can play 12 different styles of maps.
 Each map has its own unique trap mechanism and play method. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/358e6700fbf6136307cf205ff11c25a80ccb74d6.png
New props.

 Add 7 kinds of damage props.
 Add 1 defensive item.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/d73ef5a1f1cdfaa77b79308a9c1ff23721bd46f6.png
New clothes.

 We added 23 suits.
 And more! 

What are the next plans? 
We will update the new mode.

Thanks to everyone who participated in our open beta.

notes.title: Patch notes for the Button Button 0.5.2 Beta
notes.content:
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/359a3dcc6017dfe29a259ddb63a2dfe15a8ebc47.png
Hey! Guys!~_(:3 」∠)_
Button Button local battle mode DEMO is now available.
  ● It just a tentative and simple programme.
  ● Not supported the Online mode for the time being.ಥ_ಥ）
  ● Just support 2P/3P/4P battle.
  ● With the controller  identifying P3/P4 first.
  ● human's best friend, AI, is still on the way.

Fight for Light mode test:
This is a temporary programme that currently supports only Local 2/3/4 battles, with the controller  identifying P3/P4 first.
Rule: a score is scored by taking the Light Pad alone, the first 1000 points, or the top points after the time up as the winner！
